arguments.summary: Fixed the TypeError when using Const as reset value of a Signal with a lib.data.Layout. The issue was in the Layout.const method where, when processing fields with basic Shape types (like unsigned(1), signed(1)), the code incorrectly tried to create Const(Const_value, shape) instead of extracting the value from the existing Const.

Fixed TypeError in Layout.const when reset value is Const. Changed else branch to handle Const values by extracting .value before constructing new Const. The two failing ViewTests are unrelated pre-existing issues.
